Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
Jeremy Talbot checks your pool total "during your untap phase".
This can be any time during the phase, correct?

Thankfully, this cuts down on counting time, if you have the
Edge or if there's some other "gain/lose one pool during your
untap phase" effect(s) affecting you. Since, logically, at
some point during that phase, your pool will be even, and at
some point your pool will be odd. So you could choose whether
you want your Jeremy to gain or lose one blood.
